tagline.en_US: Store and query time-series metrics through a Prometheus-compatible HTTP API and web interface.

description.en_US: VictoriaMetrics is a fast, scalable time series database and monitoring solution designed to collect, store, and process large volumes of metrics data. It functions as long-term storage or a drop-in replacement for Prometheus and Graphite, supporting both PromQL and MetricsQL query languages. The platform ingests telemetry across numerous industry-standard protocols while offering high compression and low resource usage.
